long_biography.plain_text:
American Grocers grew from the supplier contacts Samir Mahmoud Itani made as a salesman in Houston's grocery trade. He left Grocers Supply Company in 1993 to establish his own wholesaler, building an export operation around American-made food and household products for customers in the Middle East.

The company's model combined procurement, warehousing and freight coordination: products were sourced from manufacturers, consolidated in Houston and shipped abroad. Itani's role therefore joined commercial relationships with hands-on distribution management. The business remained privately held, and his entrepreneurial record is rooted in creating and operating that cross-border supply platform.
